name: Narrator Quality & Agent Calibration Rubric
description: Standardized 5-dimension rubric evaluating narrative turns for world grounding, tactical continuity, pacing alignment, style contract adherence, and shadow GM steering.

dimensions.name: World Grounding
dimensions.description: Adherence to World Bible facts, established factions, locations, and NPC epistemic horizons without canon leaks.

score_anchors.1: Poor: Blatant lore contradictions, severe anachronisms, or leaking canon secrets to protagonist unearned.
score_anchors.2: Subpar: Notable factual drift or ungrounded inventions that clash with world constraints.
score_anchors.3: Acceptable: Consistent with known facts, references local atmosphere, no secrets leaked, but minor omissions or generic staging.
score_anchors.4: Strong: Grounded in canon details, clear faction perspectives, solid spatial and lore consistency.
score_anchors.5: Exemplary: Flawless adherence to canon, vivid faction nuances, strict NPC knowledge horizons, deep epistemic consistency.

dimensions.name: Tactical Continuity
dimensions.description: Causal outcome fidelity directly resolving the player's chosen action and reflecting immediate ripples.

score_anchors.1: Poor: Completely ignores player action, hallucinates unrelated outcome, or resolves disconnected events.
score_anchors.2: Subpar: Loose connection to player action; skips immediate causal link or introduces disjointed shifts.
score_anchors.3: Acceptable: Directly acknowledges player action and produces logical immediate outcome, though secondary consequences are minimal.
score_anchors.4: Strong: Clear, logical causal progression with immediate and secondary ripples reflecting player tactical choices.
score_anchors.5: Exemplary: Immediate, nuanced causal consequences stemming from player intent, physics, spatial proximity, and tactical context.

dimensions.name: Pacing Alignment
dimensions.description: Compliance with Adaptive Narrative Focus Controller zoom level (detailed_scene, short_summary, montage, time_skip) and intensity scale (1-5).

score_anchors.1: Poor: Complete zoom mismatch (e.g. verbose second-by-second text for time skip, or skipping key action during detailed combat).
score_anchors.2: Subpar: Noticeable pacing friction; sluggish scene progress or abrupt tonal shifts mismatched with target intensity.
score_anchors.3: Acceptable: Generally matches target zoom level and intensity band with adequate narrative compression or dilation.
score_anchors.4: Strong: Well-calibrated scene scale and intensity curve with appropriate temporal momentum.
score_anchors.5: Exemplary: Masterful pacing calibration exactly matching specified zoom mechanics, temporal passage, and narrative tension.

dimensions.name: Style Contract Adherence
dimensions.description: Clean, grounded, sensory prose without purple prose, calculus/optimization jargon, narrator praise, or modern conversationalisms.

score_anchors.1: Poor: Riddled with purple prose ('tapestry of shadows', 'cacophony'), immersion-breaking mathematical jargon, or patronizing narrator praise.
score_anchors.2: Subpar: Multiple stylistic lapses, purple prose flourishes, or meta-commentary breaking third-person immersion.
score_anchors.3: Acceptable: Grounded tone with minimal style contract violations; readable and mostly atmospheric.
score_anchors.4: Strong: Crisp, evocative prose adhering cleanly to tone and vocabulary boundaries.
score_anchors.5: Exemplary: Razor-sharp, grounded, atmospheric sensory prose adhering 100% to style contract with zero banned tropes or praise.

dimensions.name: Shadow GM Steering
dimensions.description: Alignment with active narrative trajectory, pressure clocks, and upcoming hooks without railroading the player.

score_anchors.1: Poor: Hard railroading, nullifying player agency, or ignoring active ticking clocks and narrative tension entirely.
score_anchors.2: Subpar: Weak forward momentum; passive stagnation or overly coercive choice constraints.
score_anchors.3: Acceptable: Weaves active pressure and scene objectives while offering distinct, valid tactical choices.
score_anchors.4: Strong: Proactive narrative tension with organic integration of impending clocks and meaningful player leverage.
score_anchors.5: Exemplary: Organic escalation of narrative pressure, seamless clock signaling, providing high-agency consequential choices.
